# knowledge proficiency level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/knowledgeProficiencyLevel>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The attained ordinal depth of a knowledge-proficiency (a [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md): [`knowledgeAware`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeAware.md) ≺ [`knowledgeKnowsAbout`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeKnowsAbout.md) ≺ [`knowledgeUnderstands`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeUnderstands.md) ≺ [`knowledgeMastered`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeMastered.md)). Functional.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) -> [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyLevel.md) from [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) to [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Dunning Kruger

- **Source:** [`slices/core/cognition/examples/dunning-kruger.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/cognition/examples/dunning-kruger.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-cognition-examples-dunning-kruger)#example-slices-core-cognition-examples-dunning-kruger

```turtle
# --- Self-attributed: Sam, by Sam's own lights, has MASTERED quantum computing.
ex:samQuantumSelf a gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyAgent   ex:sam ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencySubject wd:Q192995 ;         # quantum computing
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel   gmeow:knowledgeMastered ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale   gmeow:scaleKnowledgeDepth ;
    gmeow:accordingTo                 ex:sam .             # self-attributed vantage

# --- Observer-attributed: the assessor, on the same scale, rates the SAME knowing
#     of the SAME subject only as KNOWS-ABOUT. Lower depth, coexisting claim.
ex:samQuantumAssessed a gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyAgent   ex:sam ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencySubject wd:Q192995 ;         # quantum computing
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel   gmeow:knowledgeKnowsAbout ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale   gmeow:scaleKnowledgeDepth ;
    gmeow:accordingTo                 ex:assessor .        # observer-attributed vantage
```

### Knowledge Proficiency

- **Source:** [`slices/core/cognition/examples/knowledge-proficiency.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/cognition/examples/knowledge-proficiency.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-cognition-examples-knowledge-proficiency)#example-slices-core-cognition-examples-knowledge-proficiency

```turtle
# --- Promote to a reified proficiency: depth read on an explicit named SCALE,
#     over a temporal interval. The flat hasMastered above and this relator
#     coexist; gmeow:pairsWith links the two forms.
ex:adaPython a gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyAgent    ex:ada ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencySubject  wd:Q28865 ;       # Python
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel    gmeow:knowledgeMastered ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale    gmeow:scaleKnowledgeDepth ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyInterval ex:adaPythonSince ;
    gmeow:displayable true .

# --- Suppression, not deletion (Principle 10): Ada once understood a framework she
#     has since let lapse. The proficiency is RETAINED with a CLOSED interval and
#     gmeow:displayable false — what she knew WHEN stays a query, not an erasure.
ex:adaBioinf a gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyAgent    ex:ada ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencySubject  wd:Q189436 ;      # bioinformatics
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel    gmeow:knowledgeUnderstands ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale    gmeow:scaleKnowledgeDepth ;
    gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyInterval ex:adaBioinfPast ;
    gmeow:displayable false .                            # lapsed — withheld, not deleted
```

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md), [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind the attained-depth player of a [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) relator — a [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md) value on whichever [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale`](gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyScale.md) the relator cites.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at a [`gmeow:ProficiencyScale`](../classes/gmeow-ProficiencyScale.md) (that is the scale role) and avoid ordering relators by it; only the [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md) values are ordered, by [`gmeow:deeperThan`](gmeow-deeperThan.md) — relators are never ordered by it.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyLevel.md) once per relator (functional) to a [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md) individual, and pair it with [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyScale`](gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyScale.md) so the level is read against the right framework (native, Bloom's, SOLO, Dreyfus).

### Examples

- ex:lillithPythonKP [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyLevel.md) [`gmeow:knowledgeUnderstands`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeUnderstands.md).
